title: Throne of Shattered Blades
description: A dark demonic figure with purple energy tendrils sits atop a massive throne constructed from twisted metallic blades and debris in a destroyed landscape. Blue electrical arcs and glowing purple energy emanate from the figure and surrounding wreckage.
prompt: A towering demonic figure with glowing purple energy lines and flowing purple energy tendrils sits on a massive throne made of shattered metallic blades and twisted metal debris, blue electrical arcs crackling in the dark chaotic environment, destroyed landscape filled with broken swords and wreckage, dark fantasy atmosphere, dramatic lighting
